description: AgentJob terminal failure becomes visible via com.mohist.agent.job.failed (event + default-on 'Agent 响应失败' inbox/Hermes notification + self-response guard), and approve/reject record a declarative decidedBy operator end-to-end.

tasks.title: Emit com.mohist.agent.job.failed with lineage and prevent self-response
tasks.spec: specs/agent-response-failure/spec.md#AgentJob terminal failure emits a failure event
tasks.description: Add the com.mohist.agent.job.failed CloudEvent type and AgentJob producer family (agentid required, issue/epic/workflowrunid optional) to event infra. Inject IEventStore into AgentJobGrain and emit on every terminal-failure path (preflight, runner report, timeout, retry-bound, forced fail) via EnterTerminalStateAsync as a durable obligation retried by the existing agent-job-recovery reminder (idempotent by (source,id)); stamp agentid + business lineage; never emit on completed. Add the envelope-only self-response guard in RoutingDispatchHandler so a rule whose AgentId equals the envelope agentid is treated as no-match (logged); empty-AgentId and different-agent rules still match.
acceptanceCriteria: Each AgentJob terminal-failure path (preflight, runner report, timeout, dispatch-retry-bound, forced fail) emits exactly one com.mohist.agent.job.failed; a completed job emits none — covered by fake-based spec tests injecting a fake IEventStore.
Event envelope carries required agentid and optional issue/epic/workflowrunid lineage sourced from the job launch context; AgentJob ProducerConformance case passes.
RoutingDispatchHandler skips launch and logs when rule.AgentId == envelope agentid; a rule with a different AgentId or an empty AgentId still matches and may launch — covered by a routing spec test.

Emission survives activation loss: the recovery reminder re-appends until success and the obligation clears once emitted (idempotent retry by (source,id)) — covered by a fake-based recovery test with injected TimeProvider.
Server builds with TreatWarningsAsErrors and `npm test` (server) is green.
tasks.output: Event catalog + producer conformance + AgentJobGrain emission + RoutingDispatchHandler guard, with passing spec/unit tests
tasks.notes: Reuse the no-DbContext IEventStore.AppendAsync(CloudEvent, ct) overload so the grain keeps its grain-storage persistence story. Widen ReceiveReminder self-clean condition so agentless failed jobs keep the reminder alive until the event is emitted. Mirror issue-449's PendingSessionClose obligation pattern. Confirm at build that the watch-launch / @mention AgentJob Input retains the originating issue id (the routed path already carries it via RoutedAgentLaunchPlan.IssueNumber) so issue-scoped failures project into the inbox rather than being dropped as contextless.

tasks.title: Thread declarative decidedBy through approve/reject end-to-end
tasks.spec: specs/approval-attribution/spec.md#Every approval decision records a declarative operator
tasks.description: Add a declarative decidedBy operator to approve/reject, copying the comment-author model: ApprovalStatus/StageRun, WorkflowRun.Approve/Reject, StageApprovalResolved event, WorkflowGrain.ApproveAsync/RequestChangesAsync, ApprovalStatusView + WorkflowStatusMapper, CLI --author on mo run approve/reject, and the run-scoped + issue-scoped HTTP DTOs. Update the generic agent command reference (packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/skill-data/mohist/SKILL.md approve/reject rows + options table) to document the now-required --author. Validate identically to comment author (required, trim, reject blank or >100 chars). BREAKING: author is now required; historical rows read back with empty decidedBy.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo run approve --author supervisor` and `mo run reject --author supervisor -m ...` record decidedBy and the approval read model exposes it — covered by a spec test.
Missing, blank, or >100-char author is rejected with no state change; surrounding whitespace is trimmed — covered by unit tests mirroring the existing comment-author validation cases.
StageApprovalResolved event and ApprovalStatusView both carry decidedBy set to the recorded operator.
Historical approval rows without decidedBy read back successfully with empty decidedBy (nullable), no error.
Both run-scoped and issue-scoped approve/reject HTTP endpoints accept the author field and forward it as decidedBy.

The generic agent command reference (packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/skill-data/mohist/SKILL.md approve/reject rows + options table) documents approve/reject with the required --author; the supervisor preset (packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/presets/supervisor/instructions.md) already declares --author on approve/reject and needs no change.
Server builds with TreatWarningsAsErrors; `npm test` (server) and the CLI build are green; web typecheck is unaffected (read-model field is additive).
tasks.output: Approval domain + grain + API + CLI decidedBy plumbing, with passing spec/unit tests
tasks.notes: Independent of T-001/T-003 (issue states the two changes are each independently usable). Template to copy end-to-end: comment author at packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliCommands.Issue.Comment.cs:18 -> IssueRoutes.Dtos.cs AddCommentRequest -> IssueGrain.AddCommentAsync -> IssueCommentAdded -> IssueCommentDto. The supervisor preset already declares --author on approve/reject (presets/supervisor/instructions.md:24), mirroring its comment --author; T-002 lands the CLI/API support that preset has been expecting, so the supervisor needs no text change — only the generic skill-data/mohist/SKILL.md command reference is incomplete and must be updated.

tasks.title: Surface agent.job.failed as the default-on 'Agent 响应失败' notification (inbox + Hermes)
tasks.spec: specs/agent-response-failure/spec.md#Failure produces an inbox item under a default-on notification kind
tasks.description: Register the AgentResponseFailed notification kind default-on in both inbox and Hermes, mirroring WorkflowFailed end-to-end: NotificationKinds + IsDefined, InboxSubscriptionState default-on, HermesNotificationOptions.EnabledTypes default-on; subscribe InboxProjectionHandler and HermesIssueNotificationHandler to com.mohist.agent.job.failed with resolve mappings; add the HermesIssueNotificationRenderer branch using the payload's failureReason/failureCategory.
acceptanceCriteria: A com.mohist.agent.job.failed event resolving an issue context produces one inbox item of kind 'Agent 响应失败' by default; the kind disabled for the project produces no item; a contextless event produces no item — covered by fake-based spec tests.
With Hermes configured, the kind pushes by default; disabling the Hermes type suppresses the push — covered by a spec test using a fake Hermes webhook client.
NotificationKinds.IsDefined accepts the new kind; InboxSubscriptionState and HermesNotificationOptions default it on for new projects.
Server builds with TreatWarningsAsErrors and `npm test` (server) is green.
tasks.output: Inbox + Hermes notification wiring for the failure event, with passing spec/unit tests
tasks.notes: Depends on T-001 because the notification consumes the com.mohist.agent.job.failed event. WorkflowFailed is the closest analog; reuse its shape across NotificationKinds, InboxSubscriptionState, HermesNotificationOptions, both handlers, and the renderer.
